scorebugs._doc: Scorebug layouts read by vodx_field.parse_bug (v0.5+). Offsets are normalized frame units relative to the down&distance token (dx, dy). Field position is from the offense's view: yardline 0-100 from its own goal, yards_to_goal = 100 - yardline.

madden_bar.row: TEAM_L SCORE_L SCORE_R TEAM_R | QUARTER CLOCK PLAYCLOCK | DD SPOT (same row, |dy| <= 0.012)
madden_bar.spot: first spot-like token at dx 0.04..0.20 right of DD
madden_bar.territory_indicator: glyph before the spot is offense-relative: A / ^ / up-arrow = opponent territory (yardline = 100 - spot); V / Y / down-arrow, or a leading '7' on a 3-digit token = own territory (yardline = spot); bare number = side unknown (resolved by goal-to-go or by motion from a neighbouring snap in the same possession)
madden_bar.scores: the two numbers between TEAM_L and TEAM_R (nearest to TEAM_L + 0.065 = left, TEAM_R - 0.07 = right)

cfb_center.spot: number at dy -0.065..-0.04 and |dx| 0.03..0.065; its side (left/right of DD) = the LEFT/RIGHT team's territory
cfb_center.row2: dy -0.045..-0.012: TEAM_L (dx -0.34..-0.12), SCORE_L (dx -0.13..-0.065), QUARTER CLOCK PLAYCLOCK, SCORE_R (dx 0.065..0.13), TEAM_R (dx 0.12..0.34)
cfb_center.territory_indicator: left/right territory + possession team (left/right) per possession segment; possession from spot motion vs. gained yards, or goal-to-go; no possession evidence -> abstain
